message:
fix(ci): complete native updater input inventory (#512)

## Problem and change

Native Homebrew promotion requires the producer updater binding to
exactly match this repository’s check. The updater regression tests read
`Formula/jackin.rb`, but the check omitted that dependency. Add it to
the ordered input inventory, completing the same 15-file closure used by
Jackin’s producer.

The native binding check remains strict. Formula contents, updater
behavior, permissions, tools, and generated workflows are unchanged.

## Validation

- `mise run check`: 56 tests passed; Ruby syntax, Jactionlint,
ShellCheck, and REUSE checks passed.
- Two official Velnor 0.1.48 scratch generations match all 24 live
generated entries.
- Semantic comparison confirms this input entry is the only
configuration change.

This completes the cross-repository binding correction discovered during
the first automatic immutable preview publication after #510. The
matching Jackin change aligns its producer with this complete ordered
inventory.

Signed-off-by: Alexey Zhokhov <alexey@zhokhov.com>
